MoDi Protocol Binary Redistribution Grant 1.0

Copyright (C) 2026 Silvite. All rights reserved.

External distribution status: APPROVED by the owner (Silvite), review completed 2026-08-15.

1. Covered Application and Binary

This grant applies only to the GPL-3.0-or-later MoDi Connect application and an
unmodified Authorized Protocol Binary as defined by MoDi Protocol Source and
Binary SDK Proprietary License 1.0. The binary must match every identity and
SHA-256 value in its accompanying protocol-artifacts.v1.json manifest.

2. Activation Condition

External redistribution permission is active because the accompanying
protocol-artifacts.v1.json manifest records EXTERNAL_DISTRIBUTION_APPROVED_BY_OWNER
for the application release, approved by the owner (Silvite) on 2026-08-15.

3. Redistribution Permission After Activation

After Section 2 is satisfied, Silvite grants recipients a non-exclusive,
non-transferable permission to reproduce and convey the Authorized Protocol
Binary solely as an unmodified, integrated component of the covered MoDi
Connect application. The permission does not cover standalone SDK distribution,
hosting the binary as a general-purpose download, modification, substitution,
or extraction and redistribution apart from the covered application.

4. Conditions

Every conveyed copy must include the exact proprietary binary license, this
grant, applicable third-party notices, the exact artifact manifest, and the
MoDi Protocol Binary Linking Exception 1.0. Recipients must not remove notices,
misstate the binary's origin, include credentials, or claim that protocol source
code is supplied under this grant.

5. No Source, Trademark, or Patent License

This grant provides no Protocol Source license and no trademark or patent right.
It does not prohibit an act that applicable law makes mandatory notwithstanding
contractual restrictions.

6. Termination and Existing Rights

Permission terminates automatically upon material breach. Termination does not
purport to revoke a valid license already obtained for a previously conveyed
copy under different terms.

7. Warranty and Liability

The disclaimer of warranty and limitation of liability in the MoDi Protocol
Source and Binary SDK Proprietary License 1.0 apply to this grant.
